name: com.brendan.htmlui
description: Define Unity UIs in HTML/CSS for WebGL and WebGPU builds. Uses Chrome's HTML-in-Canvas API (layoutsubtree / drawable / paint / texElementImage2D / copyElementImageToTexture) so the DOM is composited into the Unity frame while staying fully accessible (screen readers, find-in-page, text selection, IME, keyboard navigation). Falls back to a DOM overlay in browsers without the API.

samples.description: Main menu, settings form with tabs, HUD, inventory grid, modal dialog, toasts, screen-reader announcements and an interactive world-space panel on a 3D quad.
